population: all eligible non-sealed TRAIN/DEV oracle cases after semantic/query registries freeze and before confirmatory HOLDOUT

selection_algorithm: construct eligible case x coverage-strata incidence matrix
within each status quota sort candidate cases by SHA256('157005|' + case_id) ascending
first choose cases greedily by maximum number of still-uncovered strata; break ties by seeded hash order
fill remaining status quota by seeded hash order without replacement
after all four quotas, verify every observed mandatory stratum in the eligible population has at least one sampled case
if any mandatory stratum is uncovered or any status has fewer than 30 eligible cases, STOP and version a new protocol before audit; do not silently change quota

acceptance.action_on_threshold_failure: REVISE; retain original audit; fix only in a new version and repeat the entire 120-case audit under a reviewed protocol

claim_boundary: PASS validates only the audited non-sealed sample and protocol; it does not prove perfect human correctness on unaudited or sealed cases
